/**
 * Extra Fee (Mageplaza OSC checkout): tighten vertical rhythm.
 *
 * This stylesheet is attached exclusively to the onestepcheckout_index_index
 * layout handle — it cannot leak into other pages.
 *
 * BUG-NY0M3S (SLP-139) — payment step block (#mp-extra-fee-billing):
 * Baseline measured on local (2026-09-09, 1504px viewport): gap between the rule
 * label and the first option checkbox was 49px, because the empty `.mp-description`
 * line box (20px label + 10px top/bottom inline margins) renders even when the rule
 * has no description. The Mageplaza reference demo (extra-fee-demo.mageplaza.com/hyva)
 * shows a ~0 gap. After fix: 9px.
 *
 * TASK-EPJVGG (SLP-198) — summary/place-order block (#mp-extra-fee, KO template
 * cart/extra-fee.html rendered in #opc-sidebar > #co-place-order-a
